title: Behind the Scenes of LinkedIn Recruiter: Using Open to Work
description:
Ever wondered how the Open to Work banner works for recruiters and how it can help you in your job search?

Recruiting expert Leah Dillon walks through using the Open to Work banner on LinkedIn and gives you and inside look at what it looks like behind the scenes in LinkedIn Recruiter.

She uses examples and searches in real time for candidates. You'll also learn how using the Open to Work helps boost your searchability.

Your job search is more than just a green banner, so tune into this video to learn how you can utilize LinkedIn to help you land your next job.

Want to learn more? Check out this post about utilizing the Open to Work banner to its full potential: https://www.tealhq.com/post/linkedin-open-to-work
